name: Typehug
summary: Tool and npm package that adds nonbreaking spaces to English and Polish text.
description: Typehug inserts nonbreaking spaces for English and Polish through five rule families: short words, numbers and units, initials, references and paragraph endings. It works on plain text, HTML and formatted runs; the site's playground shows a before/after comparison and inspects invisible characters, and the engine ships as ESM TypeScript packages (@typehug/en, @typehug/pl, @typehug/all) for Node.js 22+.
contains: five rule families: short words, numbers and units, initials, references, paragraph endings
plain text, HTML and formatted-run inputs
playground with before/after preview and invisible character inspector
npm packages @typehug/en, @typehug/pl, @typehug/all; ESM and TypeScript; Node.js 22+
